errors.name: AlreadyReturnedLoanError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to return a loan that is already marked as returned.

errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book is not found during lookup by title, ISBN, or author ID.

errors.name: AuthorNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an author is not found during lookup by ID or name.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a member is not found during lookup by ID or email.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a loan is not found during lookup by ID.

errors.name: InvalidMemberIDError
errors.description: Raised when a member ID provided in a borrow or return command is not a valid integer or does not reference an existing member.

errors.name: InvalidBookIDError
errors.description: Raised when a book ID provided in a borrow or return command is not a valid integer or does not reference an existing book.

errors.name: NegativeAvailableCopiesError
errors.description: Raised when a book is attempted to be created or updated with a negative number of available copies.

errors.name: MissingRequiredFieldError
errors.description: Raised when a required field (e.g., title, ISBN, member name, email) is missing in a command input.

errors.name: DuplicateEmailError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to add a member with an email that already exists in the system.
